compatibility.missing_plan: fail closed for live input and interactive mouse; never fall back to takeover
compatibility.stale_revision: refresh before live input or interactive mouse
compatibility.herdr_0_8_sidekick: unchanged in Phase 1; does not emit or consume Capability Plans

invariants: Every attached surface receives one complete plan for one Agent Session and one Surface Attachment.
Each V0 capability appears exactly once with its V0 canonical authority.
Only the Lease Holder plan allows live input and interactive mouse routing.
A pending requester remains an Observer until promotion.
History, search, copy, open, paste, and focus providers are surface-native and do not grant lease authority.
A plan is a revisioned snapshot and must be refreshed after lease state changes.
Missing, stale, malformed, or unsupported plans fail closed for live authority.
out_of_scope: V3 Pi and Codex executable surface scenarios
runtime implementation of attachment plan commands
migration of Herdr 0.8 or Sidekick from unconditional takeover
